all_posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
all_posts.cooked:
Not to be rude, but please check for similar queries on Discourse before asking your own queries too. Such topics have already been covered extensively in multiple other posts and the README.md file in your home directory.

To view any programming assignment, not just BPT, do ls /opt/se2001. You’d then have to create a directory of the same name as the assignment under ~/se2001 and do synchro show from inside it to view the assignment. Example -

cd ~
mkdir se2001
cd se2001
mkdir BPT1_problem_1
cd BPT1_problem_1
synchro show
